summary: Panning a zoomed preview now stays anchored to the fixed viewport and no longer jitters while the mouse is held still.
changelog: Anchors Gtk.GestureDrag to the stationary preview viewport instead of the document widget that moves during panning.
Eliminates the coordinate feedback loop that could make a magnified preview shake continuously, even with a stationary pointer.
Cancels any queued zoom or rotation recentering before a manual drag begins so automatic positioning cannot compete with the user.
Keeps zoom, rotation, compact controls, Cairo integration, literal CUPS text, and the realistic reprint preview unchanged.
